about_the_game:
This is an actor graphic set designed for use with the RPG Maker series.
In addition to walking graphics, battle graphics, and face graphics, the set includes:

  • Full-body standing illustrations

  • Facial expression variations for full-body images

  • 3-frame blinking animations

  • 2-frame lip-sync animations

  • And cut-in illustrations

For details on how to use features like blinking and lip-sync, please refer to the included sample project.

****************************

Pictures: 25 files
SV Actors: 1 file
Faces: 2 files
Characters: 2 files

****************************

------------------------

・This pack is for use in RPG Maker Series or the engine of your choice.

・OK to be used in Commercial projects made in RPG Maker

・You may modify some of the assets (but not redistribute them) for your own game use only.
